title: AG31024: Electronic Application In Agriculture
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Electronic measurement of engine speed, torque, wheel slip and fuel
consumption; Force sensing in upper and lower links of tractors; Microprocesser
based engine monitoring system; Controlled environment for crop production,
soil conductivity and moisture measurement; Electronic speed counter /
monitoring, remote control valves, measurement of nutrient status of crop and
soil; Photovoltaic calls for solar energy utilization; Electronic safety relay
circuits in tractor and farm machines.
